title.zh: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二: 武宗一
title.raw: 卷二十二 本紀第二十二: 武宗一 Volume 22 Annals 22: Wuzong 1

sentences.zh: 武宗仁惠宣孝皇帝，諱海山，順宗答剌麻八剌之長子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong, posthumous name Renhui Xuanxiao, taboo name Haishan, was the eldest son of Shunzong Darmabala.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong, posthumous name Renhui Xuanxiao, taboo name Haishan, was the eldest son of Shunzong Darmabala.

sentences.zh: 母曰興聖皇太后，弘吉剌氏。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Xingsheng of the Hongjira clan.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Dowager Xingsheng of the Hongjira clan.

sentences.zh: 至元十八年七月十九日生。

translations.literal: He was born on the nineteenth day of the seventh month of the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He was born on the nineteenth day of the seventh month of the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan.

sentences.zh: 成宗大德三年，以寧遠王闊闊出總兵北邊，怠於備禦，命帝即軍中代之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dade under Emperor Temür, Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu commanded troops on the northern frontier but was lax in defense; Khayishan was ordered to replace him in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Dade under Emperor Temür, Prince of Ningyuan Kuokuochu commanded troops on the northern frontier but was lax in defense; Khayishan was ordered to replace him in the army.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，與海都軍戰於闊別列之地，敗之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fourth year he fought Qaidu's army at Koipelie and defeated it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year he fought Qaidu's army at Koipelie and defeated it.

sentences.zh: 十二月，軍至按臺山，乃蠻帶部落降。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month the army reached Aitai Mountain, and the Naiman-tai tribe submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month the army reached Aitai Mountain, and the Naiman-tai tribe submitted.

sentences.zh: 五年八月朔，與海都戰於叠怯裏古之地，海都軍潰。

translations.literal: On the new moon of the eighth month of the fifth year he fought Qaidu at Djikeleg; Qaidu's army was routed.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the eighth month of the fifth year he fought Qaidu at Djikeleg; Qaidu's army was routed.

sentences.zh: 越二日，海都悉合其眾以來，大戰於合剌合塔之地，師失利，親出陣力戰，大敗之，盡獲其輜重，悉援諸王、駙馬眾軍以出。

translations.literal: Two days later Qaidu gathered all his forces and came; a great battle was fought at Khar Khata; the army suffered a reverse, but Khayishan personally went out into the ranks and fought fiercely, inflicting a great defeat, capturing all their baggage train in full, and bringing out all the princes', imperial sons-in-law's, and other armies.
translations.idiomatic: Two days later Qaidu gathered all his forces and came; a great battle was fought at Khar Khata; the army suffered a reverse, but Khayishan personally went out into the ranks and fought fiercely, inflicting a great defeat, capturing all their baggage train in full, and bringing out all the princes', imperial sons-in-law's, and other armies.

sentences.zh: 明日復戰，軍少卻，海都乘之，帝揮軍力戰，突出敵陣後，全軍而還。

translations.literal: The next day they fought again; the army fell back slightly, and Qaidu pressed the advantage; Khayishan commanded the army and fought fiercely, breaking through behind the enemy formation and returning with the whole army intact.
translations.idiomatic: The next day they fought again; the army fell back slightly, and Qaidu pressed the advantage; Khayishan commanded the army and fought fiercely, breaking through behind the enemy formation and returning with the whole army intact.

sentences.zh: 海都不得志去，旋亦死。

translations.literal: Qaidu departed without achieving his aim and soon died as well.
translations.idiomatic: Qaidu departed without achieving his aim and soon died as well.

sentences.zh: 八年十月，封帝懷寧王，賜金印，置王傅官，食瑞州六萬五千戶。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eighth year Khayishan was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaining; a gold seal was granted, princely tutor officials were established, and sixty-five thousand households of Ruizhou were assigned as his fief.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eighth year Khayishan was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaining; a gold seal was granted, princely tutor officials were established, and 65,000 households of Ruizhou were assigned as his fief.

sentences.zh: 十年七月，自脫忽思圈之地逾按臺山，追叛王斡羅思，獲其妻孥輜重；

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the tenth year, from the region of Tughusi he crossed Aitai Mountain in pursuit of the rebel prince Orus and captured his wives, children, and baggage train;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the tenth year, from the region of Tughusi he crossed Aitai Mountain in pursuit of the rebel prince Orus and captured his wives, children, and baggage train;

sentences.zh: 執叛王也孫禿阿等及駙馬伯顏。

translations.literal: the rebel princes Yesun Tu'a and others and the imperial son-in-law Bayan were seized.
translations.idiomatic: the rebel princes Yesun Tu'a and others and the imperial son-in-law Bayan were seized.

sentences.zh: 八月，至也裏的失之地，受諸降王禿滿、明裏鐵木兒、阿魯灰等降。

translations.literal: In the eighth month he reached Yelidishi and received the submission of the surrendered princes Tudum, Mingli Temür, Aruguei, and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month he reached Yelidishi and received the submission of the surrendered princes Tudum, Mingli Temür, Aruguei, and others.

sentences.zh: 海都之子察八兒逃於都瓦部，盡俘獲其家屬營帳。

translations.literal: Qaidu's son Chapar fled to Duwa's tribe; all his family members, camps, and tents were captured.
translations.idiomatic: Qaidu's son Chapar fled to Duwa's tribe; all his family members, camps, and tents were captured.

sentences.zh: 駐冬按臺山，降王禿曲滅復叛，與戰敗之，北邊悉平。

translations.literal: He wintered at Aitai Mountain; the surrendered prince Tarkhai rebelled again, was defeated in battle, and the northern frontier was entirely pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He wintered at Aitai Mountain; the surrendered prince Tarkhai rebelled again, was defeated in battle, and the northern frontier was entirely pacified.

sentences.zh: 十一年春，聞成宗崩，三月，自按臺山至於和林。

translations.literal: In the spring of the eleventh year, hearing that Emperor Temür had died, in the third month he went from Aitai Mountain to Karakorum.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the eleventh year, hearing that Emperor Temür had died, in the third month he went from Aitai Mountain to Karakorum.

sentences.zh: 諸王勛戚畢會，皆曰今阿難答、明裏鐵木兒等熒惑中宮，潛有異議；

translations.literal: Princes and meritorious kin all assembled and said that Ananda, Mingli Temür, and others were beguiling the inner palace and secretly harbored divergent designs;
translations.idiomatic: Princes and meritorious kin all assembled and said that Ananda, Mingli Temür, and others were beguiling the inner palace and secretly harbored divergent designs;

sentences.zh: 諸王也只裏昔嘗與叛王通，今亦預謀。

translations.literal: Prince Yeshili had once communicated with rebel princes and was now also involved in the plot.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Yeshili had once communicated with rebel princes and was now also involved in the plot.

sentences.zh: 既辭服伏誅，乃因闔辭勸進。

translations.literal: After they had submitted and been executed, all together they urged Khayishan to ascend the throne.
translations.idiomatic: After they had submitted and been executed, all together they urged Khayishan to ascend the throne.

sentences.zh: 帝謝曰：「吾母、吾弟在大都，俟宗親畢會，議之。

translations.literal: Khayishan declined, saying: "My mother and my younger brother are in Dadu; wait until all the imperial kin have assembled and then deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: Khayishan declined, saying, "My mother and my younger brother are in Dadu; wait until all the imperial kin have assembled and then deliberate.

sentences.zh: 」先是，成宗違豫日久，政出中宮，命仁宗與皇太后出居懷州。

translations.literal: " Earlier, when Emperor Temür had long been ill, government issued from the inner palace; the Emperor ordered Renzong and the empress dowager to leave the capital and reside at Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: " Earlier, when Emperor Temür had long been ill, government issued from the inner palace; the Emperor ordered Renzong and the empress dowager to leave the capital and reside at Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 至是，仁宗聞訃，以二月辛亥與太后俱至京師。

translations.literal: At this time Renzong, hearing the death announcement, arrived at the capital with the empress dowager on xinhai day of the second month.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Renzong, hearing the death announcement, arrived at the capital with the empress dowager on xinhai day of the second month.

sentences.zh: 安西王阿難答與諸王明裏鐵木兒已於正月庚午先至。

translations.literal: Prince of Anxi Ananda and Prince Mingli Temür had already arrived first on gengwu day of the first month.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Anxi Ananda and Prince Mingli Temür had already arrived first on gengwu day of the first month.

sentences.zh: 左丞相阿忽臺，平章八都馬辛，前中書平章伯顏，中政院使怯烈、道興等潛謀推成宗皇后伯要真氏稱制，阿難答輔之。

translations.literal: Left chancellor Ahutai, grand councillor Badmashin, former central secretariat grand councillor Bayan, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Qielie and Daoxing, and others secretly plotted to install Emperor Temür's empress Boheljen as regent, with Ananda to assist her.
translations.idiomatic: Left chancellor Ahutai, grand councillor Badmashin, former central secretariat grand councillor Bayan, Central Domestic Affairs Court commissioner Qielie and Daoxing, and others secretly plotted to install Emperor Temür's empress Boheljen as regent, with Ananda to assist her.

sentences.zh: 仁宗以右丞相哈剌哈孫之謀言於太后曰：「太祖、世祖創業艱難，今大行晏駕，德壽已薨，諸王皆疏屬，而懷寧王在朔方，此輩潛有異圖，變在朝夕，俟懷寧王至，恐亂生不測，不若先事而發。

translations.literal: Renzong, using Right Chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan's plan, spoke to the empress dowager, saying: "The Taizu and Shizu emperors founded the enterprise amid hardship; now the late emperor has passed away, Deshou has died, all the princes are distant kin, and the Prince of Huaining is in the north — these men secretly harbor divergent designs, and change may come at any moment; if we wait until the Prince of Huaining arrives, I fear disorder of unforeseeable kind; better to strike first.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong, using right chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan's plan, spoke to the empress dowager, saying, "The Taizu and Shizu emperors founded the enterprise amid hardship; now the late emperor has passed away, Deshou has died, all the princes are distant kin, and the Prince of Huaining is in the north — these men secretly harbor divergent designs, and change may come at any moment; if we wait until the Prince of Huaining arrives, I fear disorder of unforeseeable kind; better to strike first.

sentences.zh: 」遂定計，誅阿忽臺、怯列等，而遣使迎帝。

translations.literal: " The plan was settled; Ahutai, Qielie, and others were executed, and envoys were dispatched to welcome Khayishan.
translations.idiomatic: " The plan was settled; Ahutai, Qielie, and others were executed, and envoys were dispatched to welcome Khayishan.

sentences.zh: 五月，至上都。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he reached Shangdu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he reached Shangdu.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，仁宗侍太后來會，左右部諸王畢至會議，乃廢皇后伯要真氏，出居東安州，賜死；

translations.literal: On yichou day Renzong attended the empress dowager to the assembly; princes of the left and right wings all arrived for deliberation; Empress Boheljen was deposed and sent to reside at Dong'an Prefecture and granted death;
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Renzong attended the empress dowager to the assembly; princes of the left and right wings all arrived for deliberation; Empress Boheljen was deposed and sent to reside at Dong'an Prefecture and granted death;

sentences.zh: 執安西王阿難答、諸王明裏鐵木兒至上都，亦皆賜死。

translations.literal: Prince of Anxi Ananda and Prince Mingli Temür were brought to Shangdu and likewise all granted death.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Anxi Ananda and Prince Mingli Temür were brought to Shangdu and likewise all granted death.

sentences.zh: 甲申，皇帝即位於上都，受諸王文武百官朝於大安閣，大赦天下，詔曰：

translations.literal: On jiashen day the Emperor took the throne at Shangdu, received the court of princes, civil and military officials at the Great Peace Pavilion, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and issued an edict, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day the Emperor took the throne at Shangdu, received the court of princes, civil and military officials at the Great Peace Pavilion, proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm, and issued an edict, saying:

sentences.zh: 昔我太祖皇帝以武功定天下，世祖皇帝以文德洽海內，列聖相承，丕衍無疆之祚。

translations.literal: Formerly our Taizu Emperor established the realm by martial achievement, and our Shizu Emperor harmonized all within the seas by civil virtue; successive sacred rulers succeeded one another, greatly extending boundless fortune.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly our Taizu Emperor established the realm by martial achievement, and our Shizu Emperor harmonized all within the seas by civil virtue; successive sacred rulers succeeded one another, greatly extending boundless fortune.

sentences.zh: 朕自先朝，肅將天威，撫軍朔方，殆將十年，親禦甲胄，力戰卻敵者屢矣。

translations.literal: From the previous reign We have reverently borne Heaven's majesty, governing armies in the north for nearly ten years, repeatedly donning armor and fighting in person to repulse the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: From the previous reign We have reverently borne Heaven's majesty, governing armies in the north for nearly ten years, repeatedly donning armor and fighting in person to repulse the enemy.

sentences.zh: 方諸藩內附，邊事以寧，遽聞宮車晏駕，乃有宗室諸王、貴戚元勛相與定策於和林，咸以朕為世祖曾孫之嫡，裕宗正派之傳，以功以賢，宜膺大寶。

translations.literal: Just as the frontier princes submitted inward and border affairs were settled, We suddenly heard that the imperial carriage had halted; then imperial-clan princes, meritorious kin, and founding ministers together fixed policy at Karakorum, all holding that We are the direct line of Shizu's great-grandson and the legitimate transmission of Yuzong's branch, and that by merit and virtue We should receive the great treasure.
translations.idiomatic: Just as the frontier princes submitted inward and border affairs were settled, We suddenly heard that the imperial carriage had halted; then imperial-clan princes, meritorious kin, and founding ministers together fixed policy at Karakorum, all holding that We are the direct line of Shizu's great-grandson and the legitimate transmission of Yuzong's branch, and that by merit and virtue We should receive the great treasure.

sentences.zh: 朕謙讓未遑，至於再三。

translations.literal: We declined in humility and had no leisure for it, even to the second and third time.
translations.idiomatic: We declined in humility and had no leisure for it, even to the second and third time.

sentences.zh: 還至上都，宗親大臣復請於朕。

translations.literal: Returning to Shangdu, imperial kin and great ministers again petitioned Us.
translations.idiomatic: Returning to Shangdu, imperial kin and great ministers again petitioned Us.

sentences.zh: 間者奸臣乘隙，謀為不軌，賴祖宗之靈，母弟愛育黎拔力八達稟命太后，恭行天罰。

translations.literal: Recently treacherous ministers seized the interval and plotted rebellion; relying on the spirits of the ancestors, Our younger brother by the same mother Ayurbarwada received command from the empress dowager and reverently executed Heaven's punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Recently treacherous ministers seized the interval and plotted rebellion; relying on the spirits of the ancestors, Our younger brother by the same mother Ayurbarwada received command from the empress dowager and reverently executed Heaven's punishment.

sentences.zh: 內難既平，神器不可久虛，宗祧不可乏祀，合辭勸進，誠意益堅。

translations.literal: Once the internal trouble was settled, the sacred vessel could not long stand empty, nor the ancestral temple go without sacrifice; all together they urged Us to ascend, and their sincere intent grew ever firmer.
translations.idiomatic: Once the internal trouble was settled, the sacred vessel could not long stand empty, nor the ancestral temple go without sacrifice; all together they urged Us to ascend, and their sincere intent grew ever firmer.

sentences.zh: 朕勉徇輿情，於五月二十一日即皇帝位。

translations.literal: We reluctantly yielded to public sentiment and on the twenty-first day of the fifth month took the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: We reluctantly yielded to public sentiment and on the twenty-first day of the fifth month took the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 任大守重，若涉淵冰。

translations.literal: The burden is great and the charge heavy, as if treading on deep ice.
translations.idiomatic: The burden is great and the charge heavy, as if treading on deep ice.

sentences.zh: 屬嗣服之雲初，其與民更始，可大赦天下。

translations.literal: At the cloud's first rising of Our succession, We should renew beginnings with the people; a general amnesty throughout the realm is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: At the cloud's first rising of Our succession, We should renew beginnings with the people; a general amnesty throughout the realm is permitted.

sentences.zh: 存恤征戍軍士及供給繁重州郡，免上都、大都、隆興差稅三年，其餘路分，量重輕優免。

translations.literal: Care for garrison soldiers on campaign and prefectures and circuits with heavy supply burdens; remit corvée taxes at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing for three years; for the remaining routes, remit in proportion to severity.
translations.idiomatic: Care for garrison soldiers on campaign and prefectures and circuits with heavy supply burdens; remit corvée taxes at Shangdu, Dadu, and Longxing for three years; for the remaining routes, remit in proportion to severity.

sentences.zh: 雲南八番、田楊地面，免差發一年。

translations.literal: In the Yunnan bafan and Tian-Yang territories, remit requisition levies for one year.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yunnan bafan and Tian-Yang territories, remit requisition levies for one year.

sentences.zh: 其積年逋欠者，蠲之；

translations.literal: Those with arrears accumulated over years are to be remitted;
translations.idiomatic: Those with arrears accumulated over years are to be remitted;

sentences.zh: 逃移復業者，免三年。

translations.literal: those who fled and now return to their occupations are exempt for three years.
translations.idiomatic: those who fled and now return to their occupations are exempt for three years.

sentences.zh: 被災之處，山場湖泊課程，權且停罷，聽貧民采取。

translations.literal: In disaster-stricken places, mountain-forest and lake-revenue duties are temporarily suspended, and the poor are permitted to gather resources.
translations.idiomatic: In disaster-stricken places, mountain-forest and lake-revenue duties are temporarily suspended, and the poor are permitted to gather resources.

sentences.zh: 站赤消乏者，優之。

translations.literal: Where relay households are depleted, give them relief.
translations.idiomatic: Where relay households are depleted, give them relief.

sentences.zh: 經過軍馬，勿得擾民。

translations.literal: Passing armies and horses must not disturb the people.
translations.idiomatic: Passing armies and horses must not disturb the people.

sentences.zh: 諸處鐵冶，許諸人煽辦。

translations.literal: At ironworks everywhere, private persons are permitted to operate smelting on contract.
translations.idiomatic: At ironworks everywhere, private persons are permitted to operate smelting on contract.

sentences.zh: 勉勵學校，蠲儒戶差役；

translations.literal: Encourage schools, remit corvée duties for Confucian households;
translations.idiomatic: Encourage schools, remit corvée duties for Confucian households;

sentences.zh: 存問鰥寡孤獨。

translations.literal: inquire after widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary.
translations.idiomatic: inquire after widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary.

sentences.zh: 是日，追尊皇考曰皇帝，尊太母元妃曰皇太后。

translations.literal: That day Our late father was posthumously honored as emperor, and Our grand empress and original consort were honored as empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: That day Our late father was posthumously honored as emperor, and Our grand empress and original consort were honored as empress dowager.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，升通政院秩正二品，升儀鳳司為玉宸樂院，秩從二品。

translations.literal: On dinghai day the Bureau of Transmission was raised to rank 2a; the Ceremonial Phoenix Office was raised to the Jade Inner Music Bureau at rank 2b.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day the Bureau of Transmission was raised to rank 2a; the Ceremonial Phoenix Office was raised to the Jade Inner Music Bureau at rank 2b.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，加知樞密院事朵兒朵海太傅，中書右丞相哈剌哈孫答剌罕太保，並錄軍國重事；

translations.literal: On renchen day Director of Privy Council Affairs Dorjeqai was made grand preceptor; Central Secretariat Right Chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan was made grand guardian and given charge of state and military affairs;
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day director of privy council affairs Dorjeqai was made grand preceptor; central secretariat right chancellor Halaqsun Dalaqan was made grand guardian and given charge of state and military affairs;

sentences.zh: 知樞密院事塔剌海為中書左丞相，預樞密院、宣徽院事；

translations.literal: Director of Privy Council Affairs Tarqai was made left chancellor of the central secretariat and given charge of privy council and Bureau of Palace Provisions affairs;
translations.idiomatic: Director of privy council affairs Tarqai was made left chancellor of the central secretariat and given charge of privy council and Bureau of Palace Provisions affairs;

sentences.zh: 同知徽政院事床兀兒、也可紥魯忽赤阿沙不花、江浙行省平章政事明裏不花，並為中書平章政事；

translations.literal: Associate director of the Central Domestic Affairs Court Chundu, yeke jarquchi Ashabuhua, and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Minglibuhua were all made grand councillors of the central secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Associate director of the Central Domestic Affairs Court Chundu, yeke jarquchi Ashabuhua, and Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Minglibuhua were all made grand councillors of the central secretariat;

sentences.zh: 江浙行省左丞劉正為中書左丞；

translations.literal: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left associate administrator Liu Zheng was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat left associate administrator Liu Zheng was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat;

sentences.zh: 遙授中書左丞欽察、福建道宣慰使也先帖木兒，並為中書參知政事；

translations.literal: by remote appointment Central Secretariat left associate administrator Qincha and Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner Yesun Temür were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: by remote appointment central secretariat left associate administrator Qincha and Fujian Circuit pacification commissioner Yesun Temür were both made associate administrators of the central secretariat;

sentences.zh: 中書右丞、行御史中丞塔思不花為御史大夫；

translations.literal: Central Secretariat right vice chancellor and acting regional censor-in-chief Tasibuhua was made censor-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat right vice chancellor and acting regional censor-in-chief Tasibuhua was made censor-in-chief;

sentences.zh: 平章政事床兀兒為知樞密院事。

translations.literal: Grand councillor Chundu was made director of privy council affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Grand councillor Chundu was made director of privy council affairs.

sentences.zh: 特授乞臺普濟中書平章政事，延慶使抄兒赤中書右丞，同知和林等處宣慰司事塔海中書右丞，阿里中書左丞，脫脫御史大夫。

translations.literal: By special appointment Qitai Puji was made grand councillor of the central secretariat; Yanqing commissioner Cha'erchi was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; associate director of the Karakorum and other places pacification commission Tahai was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; Ali was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat; and Toghto was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: By special appointment Qitai Puji was made grand councillor of the central secretariat; Yanqing commissioner Cha'erchi was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; associate director of the Karakorum and other places pacification commission Tahai was made right vice chancellor of the central secretariat; Ali was made left vice chancellor of the central secretariat; and Toghto was made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 以大都迤北六十二驛驛戶罷乏，給鈔赒之。

translations.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon encroached upon Kang.

translations.idiomatic: Prince Babusha was granted 10,000 ingots of notes.

translations.idiomatic: Jiang-Zhe suffered flooding; the people faced famine; an edict ordered three months of relief grain; wine, vinegar, gate levies, and tax items were all remitted for one year.

translations.idiomatic: On yihai day Yongping Route was made the Princess of Lu's fief; rent and local products were all granted to her.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Jiang-Zhe branch secretariat grand councillor Tash Kayal and privy council director Chuangwu'er were both made central secretariat grand councillors.

sentences.zh: 臣恐宗親昆弟援例，自五戶絲外，余請輸之內帑。

translations.literal: I fear imperial kin and brothers will cite precedent; apart from five-household silk tribute, the remainder I request be paid into the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: I fear imperial kin and brothers will cite precedent; apart from five-household silk tribute, the remainder I request be paid into the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 其陜西運司歲辦鹽十萬引，向給安西王，以此錢斟酌與臣，惟陛下裁之。

translations.literal: The Shaanxi salt office annually handles one hundred thousand salt certificates, formerly given to the Prince of Anxi; we request this money be weighed and granted to me — may Your Majesty decide."
translations.idiomatic: The Shaanxi salt office annually handles 100,000 salt certificates, formerly given to the Prince of Anxi; we request this money be weighed and granted to me — may Your Majesty decide."

sentences.zh: 」中書計會三路租稅及鹽課所入，鈔四十萬錠。

translations.literal: The central secretariat calculated the three routes' rents and salt proceeds at four hundred thousand ingots of notes.
translations.idiomatic: The central secretariat calculated the three routes' rents and salt proceeds at 400,000 ingots of notes.

sentences.zh: 有旨：「皇太子所思甚善，歲以十萬錠給之，不足則再賜。

translations.literal: An order stated: "The crown prince's thinking is very good; each year one hundred thousand ingots shall be granted; if insufficient, grant again."
translations.idiomatic: An order stated, "The crown prince's thinking is very good; each year 100,000 ingots shall be granted; if insufficient, grant again."

sentences.zh: 」樂工毆人，刑部捕之，玉宸樂院長謂玉宸與刑部秩皆三品，官皆榮祿大夫，留不遣。

translations.literal: Music performers beat a person; the Ministry of Justice arrested them; the director of the Yuchen Music Bureau said the Yuchen Bureau and the Ministry of Justice were both rank 3, and their chiefs were both Grand Masters for Glorious Goodness — he detained and did not release them.
translations.idiomatic: Music performers beat a person; the Ministry of Justice arrested them; the director of the Yuchen Music Bureau said the Yuchen Bureau and the Ministry of Justice were both rank 3, and their chiefs were both Grand Masters for Glorious Goodness — he detained and did not release them.

sentences.zh: 中書以聞，帝曰：「凡諸司，視其資級，授之散官，不可超越。

translations.literal: The central secretariat reported this; the Emperor said: "For every office, according to their qualifications assign them nominal ranks — they may not exceed their grade.
translations.idiomatic: The central secretariat reported this; the Emperor said, "For every office, according to their qualifications assign them nominal ranks — they may not exceed their grade.

sentences.zh: 其閑冗職名官高者，遵舊制降之。

translations.literal: Those holding idle sinecures with high titles should, following the old system, be reduced."
translations.idiomatic: Those holding idle sinecures with high titles should, following the old system, be reduced."

sentences.zh: 」建康路屬州縣饑，詔免今年酒醋課。

translations.literal: Jiankang Route's subordinate prefectures and counties suffered famine; an edict remitted this year's wine and vinegar taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang Route's subordinate prefectures and counties suffered famine; an edict remitted this year's wine and vinegar taxes.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太陰犯東井。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the moon transgressed Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，中書省臣言：「前為江南大水，以茶、鹽課折收米，賑饑民。

translations.literal: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said: "Previously because of great flooding in Jiangnan, tea and salt levies were collected in rice to relieve the famished people.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day central secretariat officials said, "Previously because of great flooding in Jiangnan, tea and salt levies were collected in rice to relieve the famished people.

sentences.zh: 今商人輸米中鹽，以致米價騰湧，百姓雖獲小利，終為無益。

translations.literal: Now merchants deliver rice in exchange for salt, causing rice prices to surge; though the people gain a small profit, in the end it is of no benefit.
translations.idiomatic: Now merchants deliver rice in exchange for salt, causing rice prices to surge; though the people gain a small profit, in the end it is of no benefit.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，茶、鹽之課當如舊。

translations.literal: We your ministers consider that tea and salt levies should revert to the old way."
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers consider that tea and salt levies should revert to the old way."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，授皇太子玉冊。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the crown prince was granted the jade book.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the crown prince was granted the jade book.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以皇太子受冊禮成，帝御大明殿，受諸王、百官朝賀。

translations.literal: On jimao day, upon completion of the crown prince's investiture ceremony, the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received the court audience of princes and all officials.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day, upon completion of the crown prince's investiture ceremony, the Emperor took Great Brightness Hall and received the court audience of princes and all officials.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，中書省臣言：「皇太子謂臣等曰：吾之分地安西、平江、吉州三路，遵舊制，自達魯花赤之外，悉從常選，其常選宜速擇才能。

translations.literal: On gengchen day central secretariat officials said: "The crown prince told us: My appanages Anxi, Pingjiang, and Jizhou — following the old system, apart from the darughachi, all other regular appointments should follow regular selection; suitable talent should quickly be chosen for regular appointments."
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen day central secretariat officials said, "The crown prince told us: My appanages Anxi, Pingjiang, and Jizhou — following the old system, apart from the darughachi, all other regular appointments should follow regular selection; suitable talent should quickly be chosen for regular appointments."

sentences.zh: 」有旨：「其擇人任之。

translations.literal: An order stated: "Choose men and appoint them."
translations.idiomatic: An order stated, "Choose men and appoint them."

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，太陰犯亢。

translations.literal: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Kang.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day the moon transgressed Kang.

sentences.zh: 詔：「皇太后軍民人匠等戶租賦徭役，有司勿與，並隸徽政院。

translations.literal: An edict declared: "Rent, tax, and corvée of military and civilian households, artisans, and other households of the empress dowager — regular offices must not interfere; all are subordinate to the Huizheng Bureau."
translations.idiomatic: An edict declared, "Rent, tax, and corvée of military and civilian households, artisans, and other households of the empress dowager — regular offices must not interfere; all are subordinate to the Huizheng Bureau."

sentences.zh: 」升太僕院秩從二品。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Studs was raised to rank 2b.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Studs was raised to rank 2b.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，杭州、平江等處大饑，發糧五十萬一千二百石賑之。

translations.literal: On dinghai day Hangzhou, Pingjiang, and other places suffered great famine; five hundred one thousand two hundred shi of grain were distributed for relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day Hangzhou, Pingjiang, and other places suffered great famine; 501,200 shi of grain were distributed for relief.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，賜太師月赤察兒江南田四十頃。

translations.literal: On gengyin day Grand Preceptor Yuechiqier was granted forty qing of Jiangnan fields.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day Grand Preceptor Yuechiqier was granted 40 qing of Jiangnan fields.

sentences.zh: 時賜田悉奪還官，中書省為言，有旨：「月赤察兒自世祖時積有勛勞，非余人比，宜以前後所賜，合百頃與之。

translations.literal: At this time all granted fields were being resumed by the government; the central secretariat spoke on his behalf; an order stated: "Yuechiqier since Shizu's time has accumulated meritorious service; he is not comparable to others; all grants before and after, totaling one hundred qing, should be given him."
translations.idiomatic: At this time all granted fields were being resumed by the government; the central secretariat spoke on his behalf; an order stated, "Yuechiqier since Shizu's time has accumulated meritorious service; he is not comparable to others; all grants before and after, totaling 100 qing, should be given him."

sentences.zh: 」仍敕行省平章別不花領其歲入。

translations.literal: Still an edict ordered branch secretariat pingzhang Biebiehua to receive its annual income.
translations.idiomatic: Still an edict ordered branch secretariat pingzhang Biebiehua to receive its annual income.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，辰星犯歲星。

translations.literal: On xinmao day Mercury transgressed Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Mercury transgressed Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 從皇太子請，御史臺檢核詹事院文案。

translations.literal: At the crown prince's request, the censorate was to inspect the crown prince's household bureau documents.
translations.idiomatic: At the crown prince's request, the censorate was to inspect the crown prince's household bureau documents.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬辰朔，中書省臣言：「舊制，金虎符及金銀符典瑞院掌之，給則由中書，事已則復歸典瑞院。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renchen new moon: central secretariat officials said: "Under the old system, gold tiger tallies and gold and silver tallies were kept by the Imperial Insignia Bureau; when issued it was through the central secretariat, and when the matter ended they returned to the Imperial Insignia Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, renchen new moon: central secretariat officials said, "Under the old system, gold tiger tallies and gold and silver tallies were kept by the Imperial Insignia Bureau; when issued it was through the central secretariat, and when the matter ended they returned to the Imperial Insignia Bureau.

sentences.zh: 今出入多不由中書，下至商人，結托近侍奏請，以致泛濫，出而無歸。

translations.literal: Now issuance frequently bypasses the central secretariat; even down to merchants who cultivate connections with close attendants and memorialize — causing overflow, issued but never returned.
translations.idiomatic: Now issuance frequently bypasses the central secretariat; even down to merchants who cultivate connections with close attendants and memorialize — causing overflow, issued but never returned.

sentences.zh: 臣等請核之，自後除官及奉使應給者，非由中書省勿給。

translations.literal: We your ministers request verification; from now on, apart from appointments and envoys who should receive them, none not through the central secretariat shall receive them."
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers request verification; from now on, apart from appointments and envoys who should receive them, none not through the central secretariat shall receive them."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 又言：「今國用甚多，帑藏已乏，用及鈔母，非宜。

translations.literal: They further said: "Now state expenditures are very great and treasury stores are already depleted; use reaching the note reserve is not proper.
translations.idiomatic: They further said, "Now state expenditures are very great and treasury stores are already depleted; use reaching the note reserve is not proper.

sentences.zh: 鹽引向從運司與民為市，今權時制宜，從戶部鬻鹽引八十萬便。

translations.literal: Salt certificates were formerly traded between the transport office and the people; now adapting measures to the times, selling eight hundred thousand salt certificates through the Ministry of Revenue would be convenient."
translations.idiomatic: Salt certificates were formerly traded between the transport office and the people; now adapting measures to the times, selling 800,000 salt certificates through the Ministry of Revenue would be convenient."

sentences.zh: 」有旨：「今歲姑從所請，後勿復行。

translations.literal: An order stated: "This year for now follow your request; do not repeat it afterward."
translations.idiomatic: An order stated, "This year for now follow your request; do not repeat it afterward."

sentences.zh: 」又言：「太府院為內藏，世祖、成宗朝，遇重賜則取給中書，今所賜有逾千錠至萬錠者，皆取之太府。

translations.literal: They further said: "The Imperial Treasury serves as the inner storehouse; in Shizu and Chengzong's reigns, when heavy gifts were needed they were drawn from the central secretariat; now grants exceeding one thousand up to ten thousand ingots all come from the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: They further said, "The Imperial Treasury serves as the inner storehouse; in Shizu and Chengzong's reigns, when heavy gifts were needed they were drawn from the central secretariat; now grants exceeding 1,000 up to 10,000 ingots all come from the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 比者太府取五萬錠，已支二萬矣，今復以乏告。

translations.literal: Recently the Imperial Treasury drew fifty thousand ingots, two thousand already disbursed, and now again reports depletion.
translations.idiomatic: Recently the Imperial Treasury drew 50,000 ingots, 2,000 already disbursed, and now again reports depletion.

sentences.zh: 請自後內府所用數多者，仍取之中書。

translations.literal: We request that from now on when the inner palace needs large amounts, they still be drawn from the central secretariat."
translations.idiomatic: We request that from now on when the inner palace needs large amounts, they still be drawn from the central secretariat."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「此朕特旨，後當從所奏。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "This is my special order; afterward follow your memorial."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is my special order; afterward follow your memorial."

sentences.zh: 」乙未，貴赤塔塔兒等擾檀州民，強取米粟六百餘石，遣官訊之。

translations.literal: On yiwei day guichi Tatatu and others harassed Tanzhou commoners, forcibly taking more than six hundred shi of grain; officials were dispatched to try them.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day guichi Tatatu and others harassed Tanzhou commoners, forcibly taking more than 600 shi of grain; officials were dispatched to try them.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，幸大聖壽萬安寺。

translations.literal: On xinchou day the Emperor visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Monastery.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Monastery.

sentences.zh: 授吏部尚書察乃平章政事，領工部事。

translations.literal: Chanai, minister of personnel, was made grand councillor and placed in charge of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Chanai, minister of personnel, was made grand councillor and placed in charge of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以漢軍萬人屯田和林，命留守司以來歲正月十五日起燈山於大明殿後、延春閣前。

translations.literal: On guimao day ten thousand Han troops were garrisoned to farm at Karakorum; the garrison office was ordered to erect lamp mountains behind Great Brightness Hall and before Extended Spring Pavilion starting the fifteenth day of the first month next year.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day 10,000 Han troops were garrisoned to farm at Karakorum; the garrison office was ordered to erect lamp mountains behind Great Brightness Hall and before Extended Spring Pavilion starting the 15th day of the first month next year.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，升行泉府司為泉府院，秩正二品。

translations.literal: On gengxu day the Branch Quanfu Office was raised to Quanfu Bureau, rank 2a.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the branch Quanfu Office was raised to Quanfu Bureau, rank 2a.

sentences.zh: 以蒙古萬戶禿監鐵木兒有平內難功，加鎮國上將軍。

translations.literal: Because Mongol commander of ten thousand households Temüder had merit in pacifying the internal crisis, he was promoted to general who stabilizes the state.
translations.idiomatic: Because Mongol commander of ten thousand households Temüder had merit in pacifying the internal crisis, he was promoted to general who stabilizes the state.

sentences.zh: 升皇太子典醫署為典醫監，秩正三品。

translations.literal: The crown prince's pharmaceutical office was raised to pharmaceutical directorate, rank 3a.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince's pharmaceutical office was raised to pharmaceutical directorate, rank 3a.

sentences.zh: 山東、河南、江浙饑，禁民釀酒。

translations.literal: Shandong, Henan, and Jiang-Zhe suffered famine; commoners were forbidden to brew wine.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong, Henan, and Jiang-Zhe suffered famine; commoners were forbidden to brew wine.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以中書省言國用浩穰，民貧歲歉，詔宣政院並省佛事。

translations.literal: On dingsi day, because the central secretariat reported state expenditures vast and the people impoverished with failed harvests, an edict ordered the Xuanzheng Bureau to economize on Buddhist affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day, because the central secretariat reported state expenditures vast and the people impoverished with failed harvests, an edict ordered the Xuanzheng Bureau to economize on Buddhist affairs.

sentences.zh: 大都、上都二驛，設敕授官二員，余驛一員。

translations.literal: The two relay routes of Dadu and Shangdu each had two imperially authorized officials appointed; other relay stations one each.
translations.idiomatic: The two relay routes of Dadu and Shangdu each had two imperially authorized officials appointed; other relay stations one each.

sentences.zh: 敕諸王、公主、駙馬、使臣給璽書驛券，不許輒用圓符乘驛。

translations.literal: An edict directed princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and envoys given sealed edicts and relay vouchers — they may not presumptuously use round tallies to use relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: An edict directed princes, princesses, imperial sons-in-law, and envoys given sealed edicts and relay vouchers — they may not presumptuously use round tallies to use relay stations.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「驛戶疲乏，宜量事給驛。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Relay households are exhausted; relay service should be granted according to circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Relay households are exhausted; relay service should be granted according to circumstances.

sentences.zh: 今經費浩大，其收售寶貨，權宜停罷。

translations.literal: Now expenditures are vast; the purchase and sale of precious goods should for the moment be suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Now expenditures are vast; the purchase and sale of precious goods should for the moment be suspended.

sentences.zh: 又，陛下即位詔書不許越職奏事，比者近侍奏除官丐賞者，皆自內降旨，請今不經中書省勿行。

translations.literal: Also, upon Your Majesty's accession the edict forbade overstepping one's office in memorializing; recently close attendants memorialize on appointments and requests for rewards — all descend as orders from within; we request that from now on what does not pass through the central secretariat shall not be implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Also, upon Your Majesty's accession the edict forbade overstepping one's office in memorializing; recently close attendants memorialize on appointments and requests for rewards — all descend as orders from within; we request that from now on what does not pass through the central secretariat shall not be implemented.

sentences.zh: 又，刑法者譬之權衡，不可偏重，世祖已有定制，自元真以來，以作佛事之故，放釋有罪，失於太寬，故有司無所遵守。

translations.literal: Also, criminal law is like a balance — it may not be weighted too heavily; Shizu already had fixed regulations; since Yuanzhen, because of Buddhist affairs, the guilty have been released — excessively lenient, so that offices have nothing to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Also, criminal law is like a balance — it may not be weighted too heavily; Shizu already had fixed regulations; since Yuanzhen, because of Buddhist affairs, the guilty have been released — excessively lenient, so that offices have nothing to follow.

sentences.zh: 今請凡內外犯法之人，悉歸有司依法裁決。

translations.literal: Now we request that all who violate the law within and without, all be returned to the competent offices for judgment according to law.
translations.idiomatic: Now we request that all who violate the law within and without, all be returned to the competent offices for judgment according to law.

sentences.zh: 又，各處民饑，除行宮外，工役請悉停罷。

translations.literal: Also, where the people suffer famine in various places, apart from palace construction, labor corvée should all be suspended."
translations.idiomatic: Also, where the people suffer famine in various places, apart from palace construction, labor corvée should all be suspended."

sentences.zh: 」皆從之。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 又言：「律令者治國之急務，當以時損益。

translations.literal: They further said: "Statutes are urgent affairs in governing the state and should be revised in timely fashion.
translations.idiomatic: They further said, "Statutes are urgent affairs in governing the state and should be revised in timely fashion.

sentences.zh: 世祖嘗有旨，金《泰和律》勿用，令老臣通法律者，參酌古今，從新定制，至今尚未行。

translations.literal: Shizu once had an order that the Jin Dynasty's Taihe Code should not be used; he ordered senior ministers versed in law to consult past and present and newly fix regulations — to this day they have not been implemented.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu once had an order that the Jin Dynasty's Taihe Code should not be used; he ordered senior ministers versed in law to consult past and present and newly fix regulations — to this day they have not been implemented.

sentences.zh: 臣等謂律令重事，未可輕議，請自世祖即位以來所行條格，校讎歸一，遵而行之。

translations.literal: We your ministers consider statutes a weighty matter and not lightly to be debated; we request that from Shizu's accession onward the regulations enacted be collated, unified, and followed."
translations.idiomatic: We your ministers consider statutes a weighty matter and not lightly to be debated; we request that from Shizu's accession onward the regulations enacted be collated, unified, and followed."

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: This was approved.
translations.idiomatic: This was approved.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔曰：

translations.literal: On gengshen day an edict declared:
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day an edict declared:

sentences.zh: 仰惟祖宗應天撫運，肇啟疆宇，華夏一統，罔不率從。

translations.literal: Looking up, we consider that our ancestors answered Heaven and settled the realm, first opening the domain; China was united and none failed to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Looking up, we consider that our ancestors answered Heaven and settled the realm, first opening the domain; China was united and none failed to follow.

sentences.zh: 逮朕嗣服丕圖，纘膺景命，遵承詒訓，恪慕洪規，祗揚畏兢，未知攸濟。

translations.literal: When We inherited the great enterprise and continued to receive the glorious mandate, We respectfully upheld the instructions left to Us and reverently emulated the grand pattern, reverently carrying awe and diligence, not knowing how to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: When We inherited the great enterprise and continued to receive the glorious mandate, We respectfully upheld the instructions left to Us and reverently emulated the grand pattern, reverently carrying awe and diligence, not knowing how to succeed.

sentences.zh: 永思創業艱難之始，煢然軫念；

translations.literal: Ever mindful of the hardship at the founding of the enterprise, We are alone in anxious concern;
translations.idiomatic: Ever mindful of the hardship at the founding of the enterprise, We are alone in anxious concern;

sentences.zh: 而守成萬事之統，在予一人。

translations.literal: yet maintaining the entirety of ten thousand affairs falls upon Us alone.
translations.idiomatic: yet maintaining the entirety of ten thousand affairs falls upon Us alone.

sentences.zh: 故自即位以來，溥從寬大，量能授官，俾勤乃職，夙夜以永康兆民為急務。

translations.literal: Therefore from Our accession We have broadly followed leniency, assigning office according to capacity, enabling diligent fulfillment of duty, day and night making the enduring peace of the myriad people an urgent task.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore from Our accession We have broadly followed leniency, assigning office according to capacity, enabling diligent fulfillment of duty, day and night making the enduring peace of the myriad people an urgent task.

sentences.zh: 間者歲比不登，流民未還，官吏並緣侵漁，上下因循，和氣乖戾。

translations.literal: Recently years have repeatedly failed to yield harvests; displaced people have not returned; officials altogether encroach and exploit; above and below have been lax; the climate of harmony has turned adverse.
translations.idiomatic: Recently years have repeatedly failed to yield harvests; displaced people have not returned; officials altogether encroach and exploit; above and below have been lax; the climate of harmony has turned adverse.

sentences.zh: 是以責任股肱耳目大臣，思所以盡瘁贊襄嘉猶，朝夕入告，朕命惟允，庶事克諧，樂與率土之民，共享治安之化，邇寧遠肅，顧不韙歟。

translations.literal: Therefore we charge our arm-and-thigh ministers and ear-and-eye advisers — to think how to exhaust themselves in loyal support and good counsel, morning and evening entering to report; We command and it is assented to; affairs may all be harmonized; We joyfully share with the people throughout the realm the transformation of peace and good order; the near at peace, the far respectful — is this not good?
translations.idiomatic: Therefore we charge our chief ministers — to think how to exhaust themselves in loyal support and good counsel, morning and evening entering to report; We command and it is assented to; that affairs may all be harmonized; We joyfully share with the people throughout the realm the blessings of peace and good order; the near at peace, the far respectful — would this not be excellent?

sentences.zh: 可改大德十二年為至大元年。

translations.idiomatic: Yidu suffered flooding; the people were starving and gathered roots and tree bark for food; this year's corvée was remitted, and relief was still granted from the route's tax revenues and grain from the Zhuwang and Lijin granaries.

translations.literal: Yaqmuqur was enfeoffed as Prince of Ding; imperial son-in-law Ashi was enfeoffed as Prince of Chang; both were granted golden seals.
translations.idiomatic: Yaqmuqur was enfeoffed as Prince of Ding; imperial son-in-law Ashi was enfeoffed as Prince of Chang; both were granted golden seals.

sentences.zh: 以司徒、平章政事、領大司農李邦寧遙授左丞相。

translations.idiomatic: Minister of revenue Li Bangning, concurrently grand councillor and head of the Ministry of Revenue, was granted left chancellor by remote appointment.

translations.literal: Seventh month of autumn, on gengshen day a shooting star rose from Gouchen, traveling south, round as a chariot wheel, slightly pointed, passing through Rope Binder and extinguishing.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on gengshen day a shooting star rose from Gouchen, traveling south, round as a chariot wheel, slightly pointed, passing through Rope Binder and extinguishing.

sentences.zh: 敕以金銀歲入數少，自今毋問何人，以金銀為請奏及托之奏者，皆抵罪。

translations.literal: An edict stated: because annual silver and gold revenues are few, from now on regardless of who it is, anyone who memorializes requesting silver and gold or who has another submit such a memorial on his behalf — all are to be punished as criminals.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: because annual silver and gold revenues are few, from now on regardless of who it is, anyone who memorializes requesting silver and gold or who has another submit such a memorial on his behalf — all are to be punished as criminals.

translations.literal: Also, officials of branch secretariats, pacification commissions, and the like in various places frequently come to the capital through personal connections; hereafter unless bearing court orders they must not come to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: Also, officials of branch secretariats, pacification commissions, and the like in various places frequently come to the capital through personal connections; hereafter unless bearing court orders they must not come to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: Bandits and rebels broke out in Yunnan, Huguang, Henan, and Sichuan; military and civil officials were instructed to devote effort to pacification and governance.

translations.idiomatic: The Guangwu Kangli Guard Elite Army Command was established; central secretariat grand councillor Ashabuhua was made commander-in-chief.

translations.literal: On renxu day Prince Khudai requested establishment of a general command office, supervising four intendant offices, to survey approximately more than sixty thousand qing of riverside wasteland within the Henan circuits of Guide and Runing, collecting its annual rent; Henan Province official Gao Xing was ordered to oversee the affair.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu day Prince Khudai requested establishment of a general command office, supervising four intendant offices, to survey approximately more than 60,000 qing of riverside wasteland within the Henan circuits of Guide and Runing, collecting its annual rent; Henan Province official Gao Xing was ordered to oversee the affair.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「瀕河之地，出沒無常，遇有退灘，則為之主。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "Riverside land appears and disappears without fixed pattern; when there is a receding sandbank it is claimed as one's own.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "Riverside land appears and disappears without fixed pattern; when there is a receding sandbank it is claimed as one's own.

translations.literal: Previously there was Yimahan, who falsely claimed a provincial commission to survey land; he devoured the people like silkworms, treating all privately owned fields as wasteland; wherever he went there was disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Previously there was Yimahan, who falsely claimed a provincial commission to survey land; he devoured the people like silkworms, treating all privately owned fields as wasteland; wherever he went there was disturbance.

translations.literal: Six hundred persons including commoner Gao Rong complained to the metropolitan secretariat; his courier tallies were revoked; just as his crime was being deliberated, he obtained amnesty; now he has offered the land to the prince.
translations.idiomatic: 600 persons including commoner Gao Rong complained to the metropolitan secretariat; his courier tallies were revoked; just as his crime was being deliberated, he obtained amnesty; now he has offered the land to the prince.

translations.idiomatic: The Central Capital Resident Commission, concurrently the Kaining Route general administration, was established.

translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day Xintai County of Tai'an Prefecture was re-established.

translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day Jining suffered great flooding entering the city; an edict dispatched officials to grant 5,000 ingots of notes for relief.

translations.idiomatic: On xinwei day the Imperial Incense Bureau was established, rank 5a.

translations.literal: On renshen day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day Venus transgressed the Left Enforcer.

translations.idiomatic: Xiangshan was further made crown prince grand tutor.

translations.idiomatic: We deferentially accede to popular sentiment: on the twenty-first day of the fifth month of the eleventh year of Dade We ascended the throne at the Upper Capital.

translations.idiomatic: Tuolibuhua and twenty others were dispatched as envoys to Prince Herbandar.

translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day privy council officials said, "Under Shizu there were six privy council ministers; under Chengzong this increased to 13.

translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day tiger keeper Cherkesh was made surveillance censor.

translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the Xingsheng Palace medical superintendent office was established, primary third grade.

sentences.zh: 十一月己未，中書省臣言：「世祖時，省、院、臺及諸司皆有定員，後略有增者，成宗已嘗有旨並省。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiwei day, central secretariat officials said: "In Shizu times, the secretariat, privy council, censorate, and all offices each had fixed establishment; later there were slight increases — Chengzong already had an edict to consolidate offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiwei day, central secretariat officials said, "In Shizu times, the secretariat, privy council, censorate, and all offices each had fixed establishment; later there were slight increases — Chengzong already had an edict to consolidate offices.

sentences.zh: 邇者諸司遞升，四品者三品，三品者二品，二品者一品，一司甚至二三十員，事不改舊而官日增。

translations.literal: Recently various offices have been promoted in succession — fourth grade to third, third to second, second to first; one office even reaches twenty or thirty positions; affairs unchanged from old yet officials daily increase.
translations.idiomatic: Recently various offices have been promoted in succession — fourth grade to third, third to second, second to first; one office even reaches 20 or 30 positions; affairs unchanged from old yet officials daily increase.

sentences.zh: 請依大德十年已定員數，冗濫者從各司自與減汰。

translations.literal: Request according to the fixed numbers established in the tenth year of Dade; redundant ones let each office reduce on its own.
translations.idiomatic: Request according to the fixed numbers established in the tenth year of Dade; redundant ones let each office reduce on its own.

sentences.zh: 衙門既升，諸吏止從舊秩出官，果應例者，自如選格。

translations.literal: Where offices were promoted, clerical staff should only be appointed at their old rank; where precedent applies, follow the selection regulations as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Where offices were promoted, clerical staff should only be appointed at their old rank; where precedent applies, follow the selection regulations as usual.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On gengshen day Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 以軍五千人供造寺工役。

translations.literal: Five thousand soldiers were supplied for temple construction corvée.
translations.idiomatic: 5,000 soldiers were supplied for temple construction corvée.

sentences.zh: 增官吏俸，以至元鈔依中統鈔數給之，止其祿米，歲該四十萬石。

translations.literal: Officials' salaries were increased — Zhiyuan notes given according to Zhongtong note amounts, stopping their salary grain; amounting to four hundred thousand shi annually.
translations.idiomatic: Officials' salaries were increased — Zhiyuan notes given according to Zhongtong note amounts, stopping their salary grain; amounting to 400,000 shi annually.

sentences.zh: 吏員以九十月出身，如舊制。

translations.literal: Clerical staff by ninth-tenth month service for appointment, as in the old system.
translations.idiomatic: Clerical staff by ninth-tenth month service for appointment, as in the old system.

sentences.zh: 詔免紹興、慶元、臺州、建康、廣德田租，紹興被災尤甚，今歲又旱，凡佃戶止輸田主十分之四。

translations.literal: An edict remitted Shaoxing, Qingyuan, Taizhou, Jiankang, and Guangde field rent; Shaoxing was especially hard hit by disaster and this year drought again — all tenant households need only pay four-tenths to the landlord.
translations.idiomatic: An edict remitted Shaoxing, Qingyuan, Taizhou, Jiankang, and Guangde field rent; Shaoxing was especially hard hit by disaster and this year drought again — all tenant households need only pay four-tenths to the landlord.

sentences.zh: 山場、河濼、商稅，截日免之。

translations.literal: Mountain passes, river marshes, and commercial taxes — cut off and remitted as of the date.
translations.idiomatic: Mountain passes, river marshes, and commercial taxes — cut off and remitted as of the date.

sentences.zh: 諸路小稔，審被災者免之。

translations.literal: Where small harvests occurred in routes, confirm disaster areas and remit.
translations.idiomatic: Where small harvests occurred in routes, confirm disaster areas and remit.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賜諸王南木忽裏金印。

translations.literal: On yichou day Prince Namughuli was granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day Prince Namughuli was granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，中書省臣言：「今銓選、錢糧之法盡壞，廩藏空虛。

translations.literal: On dingmao day central secretariat officials said: "Present appointment selection and revenue-grain methods are wholly corrupted; granaries empty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day central secretariat officials said, "Present appointment selection and revenue-grain methods are wholly corrupted; granaries empty.

sentences.zh: 中都建城，大都建寺，及為諸貴人營私第，軍民不得休息。

translations.literal: Central Capital city construction, Dadu temple construction, and building private residences for various nobles — soldiers and commoners cannot rest.
translations.idiomatic: Central Capital city construction, Dadu temple construction, and building private residences for various nobles — soldiers and commoners cannot rest.

sentences.zh: 邇者用度愈廣，每賜一人，輒至萬錠，惟陛下矜察。

translations.literal: Recently expenditures grow ever greater — each time one person is granted, it reaches ten thousand ingots; we pray Your Majesty will examine with compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Recently expenditures grow ever greater — each time one person is granted, it reaches 10,000 ingots; we pray Your Majesty will examine with compassion.

sentences.zh: 」又言：「銓選、錢糧，諸司乞毋干預。

translations.literal: " They also said: "For appointment selection and revenue-grain, all offices please do not interfere.
translations.idiomatic: " They also said, "For appointment selection and revenue-grain, all offices please do not interfere.

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「已降制書，令諸人毋幹中書之政。

translations.literal: " The Emperor said: "An edict has already been issued ordering everyone not to interfere in central secretariat affairs.
translations.idiomatic: " The Emperor said, "An edict has already been issued ordering everyone not to interfere in central secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 他日或有乘朕忽忘，持內降文記及傳旨至中書省，其執之以來，朕將加罪。

translations.literal: If someday someone taking advantage of Our momentary forgetfulness brings inner edict documents and verbal orders to the central secretariat — hold them and bring them; We shall add punishment.
translations.idiomatic: If someday someone taking advantage of Our momentary forgetfulness brings inner edict documents and verbal orders to the central secretariat — hold them and bring them; We shall add punishment.

sentences.zh: 」以也兒吉尼為御史大夫。

translations.literal: " Yekejin was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: " Yekejin was made censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以乞臺普濟為右丞相，脫脫為左丞相。

translations.literal: On jisi day Chigai Puji was made right chancellor, Toghto left chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day Chigai Puji was made right chancellor, Toghto left chancellor.

sentences.zh: 既又從脫脫言，以塔思不花與乞臺普濟俱為右丞相。

translations.literal: Subsequently also following Toghto's words, Tashihwa and Chigai Puji were both made right chancellors.
translations.idiomatic: Subsequently also following Toghto's words, Tashihwa and Chigai Puji were both made right chancellors.

sentences.zh: 中書省臣言：「國用不給，請沙汰宣徽、太府、利用等院籍，定應給人數，其在上都、行省者，委官裁省。

translations.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "State revenue insufficient; request to trim the registers of the Bureau of Palace Provisions, Grand Treasury Bureau, Liyong Bureau, and other bureaus, fix the number due provision, and for those at Shangdu and branch secretariats, commission officials to cut.
translations.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "State revenue insufficient; request to trim the registers of the Bureau of Palace Provisions, Grand Treasury Bureau, Liyong Bureau, and other bureaus, fix the number due provision, and for those at Shangdu and branch secretariats, commission officials to cut.

sentences.zh: 又，行泉院專以守寶貨為任，宜禁私獻寶貨者。

translations.literal: Also, the Quanfu Bureau specializes in guarding treasures — private presentation of treasures should be forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Also, the Quanfu Bureau specializes in guarding treasures — private presentation of treasures should be forbidden.

sentences.zh: 又，天下屯田百二十餘所，由所用者多非其人，以致廢弛，除四川、甘州、應昌府、雲南為地絕遠，余當選習農務者往，與行省、宣慰司親履其地，可興者興，可廢者廢，各具籍以聞。

translations.literal: Also, throughout the empire more than one hundred twenty garrison-farm units — because those employed are mostly not the right people, leading to decay — except Sichuan, Ganzhou, Yingchang, and Yunnan as lands extremely remote, the rest should select those versed in agricultural affairs to go, with branch secretariat and pacification commission jointly going in person to inspect — cultivate where possible, abolish where possible — each compile register and report.
translations.idiomatic: Also, throughout the empire more than 120 garrison-farm units — because those employed are mostly not the right people, leading to decay — except Sichuan, Ganzhou, Yingchang, and Yunnan as lands extremely remote, the rest should select those versed in agricultural affairs to go, with branch secretariat and pacification commission jointly going in person to inspect — cultivate where possible, abolish where possible — each compile register and report.

sentences.zh: 」並從之。

translations.literal: " All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 詔：「開寧路及宣德、雲州工役，供億浩繁，其賦稅除前詔已免三年外，更免一年。

translations.literal: Edict: "For Kaining Route and Xuanfu and Yunzhou corvée — supply extremely extensive — besides three years already remitted by previous edict, remit one year more.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "For Kaining Route and Xuanfu and Yunzhou corvée — supply extremely extensive — besides 3 years already remitted by previous edict, remit 1 year more.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，罷益都諸處合剌赤等狩獵。

translations.literal: " On xinsi day hunting by qarachin and others in Yidu and various places was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: " On xinsi day hunting by qarachin and others in Yidu and various places was abolished.

sentences.zh: 以銀七百五十兩、鈔二千二百錠、幣帛三百匹施昊天寺，為水陸大會。

translations.literal: Seven hundred fifty taels of silver, two thousand two hundred ingots of notes, and three hundred bolts of silks and cloths were donated to Haotian Temple for a water-land grand assembly.
translations.idiomatic: 750 taels of silver, 2,200 ingots of notes, and 300 bolts of silks and cloths were donated to Haotian Temple for a water-land grand assembly.

sentences.zh: 癸未，皇太后造寺五臺山，摘軍六千五百人供其役。

translations.literal: On guihai day the Empress Dowager built a temple on Wutai Mountain; six thousand five hundred soldiers were requisitioned for its corvée.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the Empress Dowager built a temple on Wutai Mountain; 6,500 soldiers were requisitioned for its corvée.

sentences.zh: 閏十一月己丑，以大都米貴，發廩十萬石，減其價以糶賑貧民。

translations.literal: Intercalary eleventh month, on jichou day, because Dadu grain was expensive, granary grain of one hundred thousand shi was released at reduced price to relieve the poor.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary eleventh month, on jichou day, because Dadu grain was expensive, granary grain of 100,000 shi was released at reduced price to relieve the poor.

sentences.zh: 北來饑民有鬻子者，命有司為贖之。

translations.literal: Famine refugees from the north included those selling children; officials were ordered to redeem them.
translations.idiomatic: Famine refugees from the north included those selling children; officials were ordered to redeem them.

sentences.zh: 乙未，賜故中書右丞相完澤妻金五百兩、銀千五百兩。

translations.literal: On weimo day the widow of former central secretariat right chancellor Wanze was granted five hundred taels of gold and one thousand five hundred taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On weimo day the widow of former central secretariat right chancellor Wanze was granted 500 taels of gold and 1,500 taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 丙申，罷江南進沙糖，止富民輸粟賑饑補官。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Jiangnan tribute of granulated sugar was abolished; only wealthy commoners submitting grain for famine relief to buy office was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Jiangnan tribute of granulated sugar was abolished; only wealthy commoners submitting grain for famine relief to buy office was permitted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，禁江西、湖廣、汴梁私捕鴐鵝。

translations.literal: On dingyou day private capture of swans and geese in Jiangxi, Huguang, and Bianliang was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day private capture of swans and geese in Jiangxi, Huguang, and Bianliang was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 己亥，罷遼陽省進雕豹。

translations.literal: On jihai day tribute of carved leopards from Liaoyang province was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day tribute of carved leopards from Liaoyang province was abolished.

sentences.zh: 貴赤衛受烏江縣達魯花赤獻私戶萬，令隸縣官。

translations.literal: The Guiji Guard received as gift ten thousand private households from the Wu Jiang county darughachi; they were ordered placed under district administration.
translations.idiomatic: The Guiji Guard received as gift 10,000 private households from the Wu Jiang county darughachi; they were ordered placed under district administration.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，乞臺普濟乞賜固安田二百餘頃，從之。

translations.literal: On renyin day Chigai Puji requested grant of more than two hundred qing of Gu'an fields; approved.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day Chigai Puji requested grant of more than 200 qing of Gu'an fields; approved.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，中書省臣言：「回回商人持璽書，佩虎符，乘驛馬，名求珍異，既而以一豹上獻，復邀回賜，似此甚眾。

translations.literal: On yisi day central secretariat officials said: "Muslim merchants holding imperial edicts, wearing tiger tallies, riding relay horses, nominally seeking rarities — then after presenting one leopard for tribute, again demanding return gifts — such cases are extremely numerous.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day central secretariat officials said, "Muslim merchants holding imperial edicts, wearing tiger tallies, riding relay horses, nominally seeking rarities — then after presenting one leopard for tribute, again demanding return gifts — such cases are extremely numerous.

sentences.zh: 臣等議，虎符，國之信器，驛馬，使臣所需，今以畀諸商人，誠非所宜，乞一概追之。

translations.literal: Your subjects propose: the tiger tally is the state's credential, relay horses are what envoys need — to give these to merchants is truly inappropriate; we pray all be recovered.
translations.idiomatic: Your subjects propose: the tiger tally is the state's credential, relay horses are what envoys need — to give these to merchants is truly inappropriate; we pray all be recovered.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: " Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 罷順德、廣平鐵冶提舉司，聽民自便，有司稅之如舊。

translations.literal: Shunde and Guangping iron smelting intendant offices were abolished; commoners left to their own devices; officials tax as before.
translations.idiomatic: Shunde and Guangping iron smelting intendant offices were abolished; commoners left to their own devices; officials tax as before.

sentences.zh: 丁未，復立汴梁路之項城縣。

translations.literal: On dingwei day Xiangcheng County of Bianliang Route was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day Xiangcheng County of Bianliang Route was re-established.

sentences.zh: 以杭州、紹興、建康等路歲比饑饉，今年酒課免十分之三。

translations.literal: Because Hangzhou, Shaoxing, Jiankang, and other routes had famine year after year, this year's liquor tax was remitted three-tenths.
translations.idiomatic: Because Hangzhou, Shaoxing, Jiankang, and other routes had famine year after year, this year's liquor tax was remitted three-tenths.

sentences.zh: 敕河西僧戶準先朝定制，從軍輸稅，一與民同。

translations.literal: Edict: Hexi monk households follow prior dynasty fixed regulations — with military service pay taxes, the same as commoners.
translations.idiomatic: Edict: Hexi monk households follow prior dynasty fixed regulations — with military service pay taxes, the same as commoners.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，答剌罕哈剌哈孫卒。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Halaqsun Dalaqan died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Halaqsun Dalaqan died.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚申，封和郎撒為隴王，賜金印。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengshen day Holangsa was enfeoffed as Prince of Long and granted a gold seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengshen day, Holangsa was enfeoffed as Prince of Long and granted a gold seal.

sentences.zh: 平江路民有隸謹的裏部者，依舊制，差賦與民一體均當。

translations.literal: Commoners in Pingjiang Route attached to Jindili's following — per old regulations, corvée and levies same as commoners equally borne.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners in Pingjiang Route attached to Jindili's following — per old regulations, corvée and levies same as commoners equally borne.

sentences.zh: 雲南畏吾兒一千人居荊襄，雲南省臣言：「世祖有旨使歸雲南，以佐征討。

translations.literal: One thousand Uighurs of Yunnan dwelt in Jingxiang; Yunnan branch secretariat officials said: "Shizu had an edict ordering them to return to Yunnan to assist in campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: 1,000 Uighurs of Yunnan dwelt in Jingxiang; Yunnan branch secretariat officials said, "Shizu had an edict ordering them to return to Yunnan to assist in campaigns.

sentences.zh: 」中書省臣議發還為是，從之。

translations.literal: " Central secretariat officials deliberated that dispatching them back was correct; approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Central secretariat officials deliberated that dispatching them back was correct; approved.

sentences.zh: 中都立開寧縣，降隆興為源州，升蔚州為蔚昌府。

translations.literal: Kaining County was established in the Central Capital; Longxing was demoted to Yuan Prefecture; Wei Prefecture was promoted to Weichang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Kaining County was established in the Central Capital; Longxing was demoted to Yuan Prefecture; Wei Prefecture was promoted to Weichang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 省河東宣慰司，以大同路隸中都留守司，冀寧、晉寧二路隸中書省。

translations.literal: Hedong pacification commission was abolished; Datong Route was placed under the Central Capital resident commission; Jining and Jinning routes were placed under the central secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong pacification commission was abolished; Datong Route was placed under the Central Capital resident commission; Jining and Jinning routes were placed under the central secretariat.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以平章政事、商議中書省事、太子賓客王太亨行太子詹事，平章軍國重事、太子少詹事大慈都為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day pingzhang political affairs negotiator of central secretariat affairs and Crown Prince guest Wang Taiheng was made acting Crown Prince household superintendent; pingzhang military and state weighty affairs and Crown Prince junior household superintendent Daci was made Crown Prince household superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day pingzhang political affairs negotiator of central secretariat affairs and Crown Prince guest Wang Taiheng was made acting Crown Prince household superintendent; pingzhang military and state weighty affairs and Crown Prince junior household superintendent Daci was made Crown Prince household superintendent.

sentences.zh: 賜御史臺官及監察御史宴服。

translations.literal: Banquet robes were granted to censorate officials and surveillance censors.
translations.idiomatic: Banquet robes were granted to censorate officials and surveillance censors.
